title: CHTV Challenge 1

[[Image:flag_fi.gif]] [[Milton]] faced [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Reppie]] in the first match in a series of challenge games arranged by [[Image:flag_us.gif]] [[Donking]] from [[CHTV]]. It was the first official duel for Milton after 2004. All tb5 duel maps were played in the following order: dm4, dm6, ztndm3, aerowalk, dm2. Milton won the first three maps thus securing the victory but the remaining two maps were played anyway.

* November 23rd, [[2008]]
